name: Fractera Design
shortDescription: The design of the project as its own element: colours, fonts, type, shapes and block settings live here, the architect edits them here, and every element of the node re-styles itself the moment they are saved.
longDescription: The shared look of the node: colours of the light and dark theme, fonts, type, shapes and block settings. The architect edits them on /<lang>/architect/*; every element takes them over MCP (/mcp: settings_version, get_project_settings, subscribe) with the node key, and after a save this element signals every subscribed address (POST {version} with X-Settings-Key). Defaults in settings/design/defaults.json, the owner patch in data/settings/design.json.
accepts: The node key (X-Settings-Key) to read; the architect session (through the node sign-in element) to write.
returns: The design settings: { ok, kind, defaults, patch, config } — config is the owner patch over the defaults.
